networks.name: imali_shop_book
networks.description: Keep a shop's book from plain messages in any language: sales, stock, spending and who owes, with reports, a trading statement and supplier prices.
sample_queries: Nimeuza mikate 3 na maziwa 2, pesa taslimu
Juma took 2 bags of sugar on credit
How much did I make in the last 7 days, and what sells most?
Write a statement of my last 30 days of trading for my landlord
Which items are low, and what would Bonde Wholesale charge to restock them?
Send KSh 500 to Juma by M-Pesa

peer_policy.note: Local agents, page-local actions and the Bonde Wholesale agent network only. The visitor approves each contact with another site.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
